annotations.title: Read a profile, post or guide

description: Read one Knowasiak profile, post or help guide in full, as Markdown, by the id from search (e.g. "profile:AdityaGaurav", "post:36405" or "help:discover-people"), or by its knowasiak.com address. A profile includes its links and recent posts; a post its replies.

id.description: An id from search: "profile:<username>", "post:<number>", "help:<slug>" or "page:<slug>"; or a knowasiak.com URL.
